title: Sotoon cloud official price list
price_unit_warning: PDF values are in rials. DO NOT treat as tomans. Convert toman = IRR / 10.
cover_note: Despite filename Spring 1405, cover states valid until end of Esfand 1405. Confirm superseding documents independently.

original_document.text_layer: tables are images; the transcription is manual, not OCR

prices/vm_gen2.csv.pricing: Compute base + disk GB-month + IP monthly + optional LB; prices vary by data center

prices/k8s_gen2.csv.pricing: Cluster subscription + per node support, optional extra control-plane resources; underlying worker compute/storage may be billed separately
prices/k8s_gen2.csv.scope: Only Gen2 KaaS; excludes Gen1 legacy cluster tariffs

prices/object_storage.csv.pricing: Capacity (class and region), request count (class and type), outbound traffic progressive bands; storage-origin traffic from Sotoon CDN free per brochure

prices/dbaas_gen2.csv.pricing: Gen2 database compute bundle by region + disk GB-month; excludes legacy Gen1

prices/cdn.csv.pricing: Tiered bandwidth with Iran/outside Iran; requests, image processing, log volume, IP, TLS, DNS, video and smart routing

interpretation_notes: Prices are per month for monthly bundles and per gigabyte or request unit for usage tariffs as printed; do not add together unlike metering units.
Storage traffic bands are preserved by textual successive-tier labels, without inferred numeric thresholds, because the catalogue mixes GB/TB/PB and does not define decimal versus binary conversion.
Gen2 VM configurations appear to be 1 core plus fixed RAM bundle; source images should be checked for exact CPU and RAM and dedicated/shared classifications before publishing.
CDN tier schedule does not explicitly specify whether progressive billing applies to every tier; assume incremental only after checkout/API validation.
All numeric entries were manually transcribed from rendered pages, not generated using OCR. Review against source before production.
Sotoon Object Storage egress classes page 7 and CDN page 8 both have tiered GB traffic tariffs; do not conflate them.
Price sheet is standalone offline observation, not a continuously verified live price.
open_review_items: Every Gen2 compute bundle is 1 vCPU (C1 1/2, G1 1/4, M1 1/8, E1 1/2 shared). The 4/8, 16/32 and 32/64 VM references cannot be matched without an explicit stacking assumption.
Region is a datacenter (Bourse, Neda, Sabalan) with roughly 10% price spread; the dashboard needs a documented region policy.
Object Storage egress rows keep textual band labels in notes and leave band_lower/band_upper empty, while CDN rows carry numeric GB bounds. Scenario calculations need numeric bounds for both.
Object Storage request taxonomy is inconsistent: Archive uses read_requests and partial_read_requests, HiCap and Hiops use a single requests component.
CDN each_ip is 250,000,000 IRR (25,000,000 Toman) per IP-month, far outside the rest of the sheet. Verify against the source page before publishing.
CDN log pricing (9,600 IRR per 10,000 logs) and K8s cluster subscriptions (17,000,000 and 40,000,000 Toman per month) also deserve a second look.
Archive egress is more expensive than HiCap egress, which is unusual; confirm the class ordering was not transposed.
